step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram is divided into two main sections: Spot.io (SaaS Platform) and Client environment. Spot.io side contains EC2 (Data Collectors), Aurora, SageMaker, and EKS. The Client side contains CloudFormation, IAM, EKS, and Spot Instance(s). Arrows depict data collection, ML predictions, and cross-account orchestration for managing Spot instances.
